messages:
sam: Heads up — bringing up hf 'chat-legal-v1' on RW and our reranker emb evals tanked, nDCG down ~12%. Suspect tokenizer/pooling mismatch between HF conversion and RW runtime. details below.

olivia: ugh, can you paste the conversion flags you used? did you run the hf->rw token mapping script or just used raw tokenizer files?

sam: I used the automated converter (hf2rw-convert v0.9) on the repo model, minimal flags: `--tokenizer . --config config.json --keep-special`. looked fine but embeddings differ. quick repro: HF mean pooling of last hidden vs RW default uses CLS pooling for reranker.

raj: that would explain a lot. our reranker evals expect CLS token to be at index 0 (`[CLS]`) but many HF chat models use `<s>`/`</s>` or rely on sentencepiece BOS/EOS. did the converted `special_tokens_map` map `[CLS]` properly?

sam: here's the config.json snippet from the converted artifact:
```json
{
  "bos_token": "<s>",
  "eos_token": "</s>",
  "unk_token": "<unk>",
  "pad_token": "<pad>",
  "cls_token": "[CLS]",
  "sep_token": "[SEP]"
}
```
but tokenizer.vocab still has `<s>` as 0. So `cls_token` set to `[CLS]` but that token isn't in vocab -> tokenization falls back to subword pieces.

jen: oof. so RW runtime sees `cls_token` present in config but tokenizer encodes differently. that will shift indices and pooling positions. can you show tokenized outputs for a short prompt HF vs RW?

sam: yes. prompt: "Summarize the doc."
HF tokenizer ids: `[25, 987, 1204, 2]` (BOS=1 not present because HF stripped), pooled embedding (mean): shape (768,)
RW tokenizer ids (converted): `[1, 25, 987, 1204, 2]` where 1 is `<s>` and our code treats index 0 as CLS so pooling uses wrong vector.

marta: that mismatch (cls at different offset) will move the whole batch kv cache and break reranker scoring. quick fix: ensure `cls_token` equals vocab token used by tokenizer (eg set `cls_token` to `<s>` in config) or change pooling policy to `mean_pool` for that model.

sam: tried setting `cls_token` to `<s>` in config and reuploading — metrics come back ~+8% nDCG but still not identical. found another issue: truncation strategy. HF conversion had `truncation_strategy: 'longest_first'`, but RW runtime picks `right_truncation` by default for embeddings. for reranker, we need consistent chunking.

olivia: are we normalizing the prompt->chat template mapping? HF chat templates sometimes wrap messages like `<<SYS>>` and RW uses role tokens. If messages are concatenated differently, token counts shift and truncation chops different parts.

sam: exact. example HF chat template for model: `{"system": "<s>[SYS]", "user": "<s>[USR]"}` vs RW expects explicit `system:`/`user:` separators. so the serialized string length changes and where truncation happens differs.

raj: recommendation: during conversion we should run a small suite: 1) verify special_tokens_map token IDs match tokenizer.vocab 2) run a deterministic chat-serializer and compare tokenization for 50 golden prompts 3) enforce truncation config: `truncation_strategy: longest_first` vs `right` explicitly in the model metadata. I'll open PR to the converter.

jen: also add a CI eval that computes cosine similarity between HF-embeds and RW-embeds for a small prompt set and fail if mean cosine < 0.95. that would catch quantization/conv mapping regressions.

marta: one edgecase: some HF tokenizers have special handling for leading spaces causing different token boundaries (`' Hello'` vs `'Hello'`). Make sure our chat-serializer normalizes whitespace consistently.

sam: test commands I ran:
```bash
# convert
python hf2rw_convert.py --model_dir ./hf/chat-legal-v1 --out ./converted --force-map-specials
# tokenize compare
python scripts/token_compare.py --hf ./hf/chat-legal-v1 --rw ./converted --prompts prompts.json
```
logs: `mean_cosine: 0.86, std: 0.04` before cls fix -> `mean_cosine: 0.94` after cls set to `<s>` but still nDCG gap.

raj: thanks. I'll prototype converter patch to prefer existing vocab tokens when setting `cls_token` (if `[CLS]` not in vocab, fall back to `bos_token` or first token). also add explicit `truncation_strategy` field to output metadata.

build-bot: PR 4523 opened by raj: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/4523 — adds special token reconciliation + truncation metadata + ci cosine check.

sam: awesome. follow-ups: can we also surface in the console per-model "tokenizer mismatches" warning during onboarding? would save chasing.

olivia: +1 UX. adding a small note to onboarding docs and a warning banner seems low-effort.

jen: I'll add reranker eval to nightly once PR merges. if we still see >5% nDCG drop after all of this we'll dig into quantization/kv-cache ordering.

sam: thanks everyone — will rerun full benchmark after PR lands and post results here. :thumbsup:
